release_notes: Added automatic update checking on startup with GitHub-hosted release metadata support
Improved XML comparison logic to better handle large nested structures and repeated elements
Enhanced side-by-side difference viewer with improved line alignment and synchronization
Added mapping validation health metrics including coverage, mapped field counts, and skipped field analysis
Improved report generation performance for large comparison results and export scenarios
Fixed several UI layout issues affecting dark mode and high-DPI display environments
Added installer download support with automatic update workflow integration
General bug fixes, stability improvements, and user interface refinements
